# vendor/

`fragateiro-physics/` is an unmodified copy of `src/physics/` from
https://github.com/TagusNavyVirtualMuseum/fragateiro (CC0 1.0), the web sailing game this tool
targets. The workbench uses it to run scripted sails and replay recordings with the same physics
the game uses. Do not edit it here; refresh it with `domains/sailing/scripts/sync-fragateiro.sh`.

Source commit: see `fragateiro-physics/SOURCE`.
